dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type of systems parameterized by real constants K and ρ. Its supplied constructor packages ρ ≠ 0, functions p,u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, and the pointwise derivative and equation conditions in D011 at every real x,t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The second conjunct quantifies over already supplied systems satisfying these conditions, rather than arbitrary pairs of functions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The second field of a system, its real-valued pressure function p(x,t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies p in the identity w(x,t) = p(x,t) + (ρc)u(x,t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The third field of a system, its real-valued velocity function u(x,t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies u in the identity w(x,t) = p(x,t) + (ρc)u(x,t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real c, the matrix with row and column index set Fin 1 whose sole entry is c.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The spectral assertion concerns the one-dimensional matrix [c].

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m by m real matrix, the predicate D009 asserting a basis of real eigenvectors with real eigenvalues.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Asserts real diagonalizability of [c]; it does not require distinct eigenvalues or an orthonormal basis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-valued specialization of D008: both separate partial derivatives exist at (x,t), and q_t(x,t) + c q_x(x,t) = 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the transport condition asserted locally for the translated profile and globally for w.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type E and profile f : ℝ → E, defines q(x,t) = f(x − ct).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In the target E is ℝ; both the derivative conclusion and the characteristic identity use this explicitly defined q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real normed vector space E, there exist qt,qx in E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + c • qx = 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires actual separate derivative witnesses at each asserted point. For real-valued q, scalar multiplication is ordinary multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a finite index type ι and real matrix A indexed by ι, there exist λ : ι → ℝ and a basis b of the real vector space ι → ℝ, indexed by ι, such that A b_i = λ_i b_i for every i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At ι = Fin 1 this gives a single nonzero basis vector and a real eigenvalue for [c]. The eigenvalue is not explicitly identified in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a system from ρ ≠ 0, pressure and velocity functions on ℝ², and proofs of D011 at all real x,t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Exposes the nonzero-density restriction and the global pointwise differential equations built into the system binder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: There exist real pt,px,ut,ux that are respectively the time and space derivatives of pressure and velocity at (x,t), with pt + K ux = 0 and ut + ρ⁻¹ px = 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The input system has all four separate partial derivatives everywhere and satisfies p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + ρ⁻¹ p_x = 0 everywhere.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real scalar multiplication on any real normed vector space is jointly continuous.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the continuity structure needed for the generalized derivative predicate in D008, without an extra target hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real scalar multiplication on ℝ is jointly continuous.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the real derivative predicates in the system equations without restricting p or u.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction: both propositions hold.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires both main assertions and all nested spectral, monotonicity, derivative, equality, and positivity conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Jointly continuous multiplication gives jointly continuous self-scalar multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies continuous real scalar multiplication for HasDerivAt.

dependency_coverage.name: DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the stronger dense-norm property while retaining a nontrivially normed field.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the standard real field eligible as the scalar field for differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation from a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the real division used in K/ρ.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality of two objects of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All displayed identities are exact equalities, including the speed, function values, and differential equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification over the indicated type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Introduces eigenvalues and a basis, pointwise derivative witnesses, and the speed and function witnesses in the second conjunct.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the selected heterogeneous addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here gives ordinary real addition, and vector addition in the generalized transport definition.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the selected heterogeneous division operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here forms the real ratio K/ρ.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the selected heterogeneous multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here forms ordinary real products such as ct, ρc, and K u_x.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the selected heterogeneous subtraction operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here forms the real profile argument x − ct.

dependency_coverage.name: HasDerivAt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, expressed using the neighborhood filter at that point and a fixed base point.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All derivatives are ordinary unrestricted derivatives at real points, not one-sided, weak, or merely formal derivatives.

dependency_coverage.name: IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: A topological ring supplies the corresponding topological semiring structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Part of the structure chain establishing continuous multiplication on ℝ for differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: A topological semiring has jointly continuous multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies continuous real multiplication and hence continuous self-scalar multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the selected strict comparison relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All inequalities in the target are strict inequalities in ℝ.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the matrix dimension 1 and the sizes of finite index sets.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the commutativity field of a nonunital nonassociative commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Preserves the real arithmetic used by the topological structures.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses from the structure interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the semiring interface used for continuity and matrix operations without changing real arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the algebraic nonunital commutative ring from its normed version.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Preserves the norm and real operations in the derivative instance chain.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric of a seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the additive seminormed structure underlying real normed-space differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Preserves the standard real field and norm throughout derivative elaboration.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains normed commutative ring operations and metric while forgetting the unit requirement.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides a compatible real algebraic and topological structure, adding no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring using the same norm and operations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies compatible real seminormed structures for HasDerivAt.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedField.toNormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the normed commutative ring underlying a normed field.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Retains the real norm and arithmetic needed by the derivative topology.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedField.toNormedSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with scalar action given by multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedSpace.toModule
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the module structure of a normed vector space.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommGroup

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real metric structure with distance d(x,y) = |x − y|.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative square root after replacing a real input by its nonnegative part; thus it is zero for negative inputs.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a seminormed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Retains the real seminorm and pseudometric used in the topology chain.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the pseudometric from a seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the metric-derived real topology appearing in differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the topology of a uniform space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the topology in which the derivative limits and scalar continuity are interpreted.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets the numeral 0 as the designated zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures that every real zero literal denotes the additive identity.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Uses a homogeneous addition operation as heterogeneous addition with identical input and output types.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes addition notation to ordinary real or vector addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Uses a homogeneous division operation as heterogeneous division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes K/ρ to real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Uses a homogeneous multiplication operation as heterogeneous multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the target's real product notation to real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Uses a homogeneous subtraction operation as heterogeneous subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes x − ct to real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instIsTopologicalRingReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real addition, multiplication, and negation have the continuity properties of a topological ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies background continuity of real operations, not regularity assumptions on the profile or system functions.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets the natural numeral n as n itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the matrix dimension literal as the natural number 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the type of natural indices i with 0 ≤ i < n.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Enumerates every element of Fin n exactly once as a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the finite indexing needed for the one-dimensional matrix-vector product and spectral predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real additive commutative group with its standard norm and metric.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiates the real-valued transport predicate's normed additive structure.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Views an additive commutative group as a commutative subtraction monoid, preserving subtraction and negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies inherited additive structure, including zero, in the transport predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMagma.toAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the addition used for vector-valued derivative witnesses.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains associative commutative addition while forgetting the zero requirement.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Part of the inherited addition structure for derivative values and vector spaces.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains commutative addition while forgetting associativity from the structure interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects the additive structure to the addition operation in the transport equation.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains addition, zero, and their identity laws from an additive monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies compatible additive zero structure in derivative and scalar-action expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: AddZero.toZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts zero from a structure containing addition and zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the zero element in the generalized transport equation.

dependency_coverage.name: AddZeroClass.toAddZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains the addition and zero operations while forgetting their identity-law fields.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.id

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.toSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.

dependency_coverage.name: CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the unit requirement while retaining commutative ring operations.

dependency_coverage.name: CommSemiring.toSemiring

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe

dependency_coverage.name: DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul

dependency_coverage.name: DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass

dependency_coverage.name: ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets additive inverses while retaining commutative addition and zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the additive monoid interface required by module and scalar-action structures.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommGroup.toAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity from an additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Preserves additive operations in the generalized derivative infrastructure.

dependency_coverage.name: AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts addition, zero, negation, and subtraction structure from an additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies inherited additive data used by derivative-value structures.

dependency_coverage.name: ContinuousSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scalar-action map (a,v) ↦ a • v is jointly continuous.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A background requirement of HasDerivAt, supplied by the normed structures rather than assumed of the profile or system.

dependency_coverage.name: DivisionSemiring.toSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the semiring structure from a division semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies compatible scalar algebra in the real derivative and module instances.

dependency_coverage.name: Field.toSemifield
dependency_coverage.meaning: Views a field as a semifield while preserving its addition, multiplication, inverse, and division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A structure conversion for real scalar operations, with no new restriction on parameters.

dependency_coverage.name: Inv.inv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the selected inverse operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms ρ⁻¹ in the system equation u_t + ρ⁻¹ p_x = 0.

dependency_coverage.name: MonoidWithZero.toMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the multiplicative monoid structure from a monoid with zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports self-scalar multiplication while retaining zero in the underlying real domain.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedField.toField
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the algebraic field from a normed field.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the real algebraic structure underlying differentiation and scalar multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instInv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real reciprocal operation, totalized by assigning zero to the reciprocal of zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Since a system requires ρ ≠ 0, the coefficient ρ⁻¹ in its equation is the ordinary nonzero reciprocal.

dependency_coverage.name: Semifield.toDivisionSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains division-semiring structure while forgetting multiplicative commutativity from the interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Preserves the real scalar operations used by the derivative infrastructure.

dependency_coverage.name: Semiring.toMonoidWithZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts multiplication, one, zero, and the absorbing-zero laws from a semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the real self-action used as scalar multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts addition and zero from a structure also carrying negation and subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies inherited additive monoid structure for derivative codomains.

dependency_coverage.name: instSMulOfMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines self-scalar multiplication by a • b = ab.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the real scalar factors in eigenvector and transport equations ordinary multiplication.

binders: The proposition is a conjunction of two independently quantified assertions.
First assertion: for every real c, assuming c > 0.

Within its spectral conclusion, there exist λ : Fin 1 → ℝ and a real basis b of Fin 1 → ℝ indexed by Fin 1, such that the eigenvector equation holds for every i : Fin 1. These witnesses may depend on c.
Within its monotonicity conclusion, for every real x,t₁,t₂, assuming t₁ < t₂.
Within its profile conclusion, for every f : ℝ → ℝ, every real a, and every real x,t, assuming f has derivative a at x − ct. The implicit Lean binders for f and a are universal.
Second assertion: for every real K and ρ and every system S : LocalDef001 K ρ, assuming K > 0 and ρ > 0. The implicit Lean binders for K and ρ are universal.
A system supplies p,u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, a proof that ρ ≠ 0, and, for every real x,t, real derivative witnesses pt,px,ut,ux satisfying the four derivative assertions and two equations.

For each such system and positive parameters, there exists a real c, and then a function w : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, satisfying the asserted equalities and transport condition at every real x,t. The witness w may depend on the system, parameters, and c; neither c nor w varies with the subsequently quantified x,t.
Each transport condition at a point existentially quantifies two real derivative values qt,qx. These witnesses may depend on that point and the function and speed.
hypotheses: The first main assertion is conditional on c > 0.
The strict-increase subassertion additionally assumes t₁ < t₂.
The profile subassertion additionally assumes HasDerivAt f a (x − ct), meaning that f has ordinary real derivative a at x − ct.
The second main assertion assumes a supplied system, K > 0, and ρ > 0.
The supplied system incorporates ρ ≠ 0 and, at every (x,t) ∈ ℝ², existence of the separate derivatives p_t,p_x,u_t,u_x satisfying p_t(x,t) + K u_x(x,t) = 0 and u_t(x,t) + ρ⁻¹ p_x(x,t) = 0.
conclusions: For every c > 0, the one by one matrix [c] admits a real eigenbasis: there exist λ : Fin 1 → ℝ and a basis (b_i) indexed by Fin 1 of the real vector space Fin 1 → ℝ such that [c]b_i = λ_i b_i for every i.
For every c > 0 and all real x,t₁,t₂ with t₁ < t₂, one has x + ct₁ < x + ct₂.

For every c > 0, f : ℝ → ℝ, a ∈ ℝ, and x,t ∈ ℝ, if f has derivative a at x − ct, then q(x,t) = f(x − ct) has both separate partial derivatives at (x,t), with q_t(x,t) + c q_x(x,t) = 0, and q(x + ct,t) = f(x). Both conclusions occur under that same derivative hypothesis.

For every supplied system with K > 0 and ρ > 0, there exist c ∈ ℝ and w : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ such that c = √(K/ρ), c > 0, and, for every real x,t, w(x,t) = p(x,t) + (ρc)u(x,t). At every real x,t, w has both separate partial derivatives and satisfies w_t(x,t) + c w_x(x,t) = 0.
mathematical_definitions: Write T(q,c,x,t) for: there exist real qt,qx such that the derivative of τ ↦ q(x,τ) at t is qt, the derivative of ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) at x is qx, and qt + c qx = 0.
The translated-profile function is q_f,c(x,t) = f(x − ct), with space as the first argument and time as the second.
The spectral predicate on a finite real square matrix A means existence of real eigenvalues λ_i and a full real algebraic basis b_i of its coordinate space satisfying Ab_i = λ_i b_i for each index.
The coefficient matrix in this proposition has index set Fin 1 = {0} and entry A_00 = c.

A system with parameters K and ρ packages nonzero ρ, two real-valued functions p and u on all of ℝ², and the four separate partial derivatives and two equations specified in the hypotheses at every point.
The square root is the nonnegative real square root on nonnegative inputs, extended by zero to negative inputs. Under K > 0 and ρ > 0 its argument K/ρ is positive.
translation.proposition_plain_english: Both of the following hold. First, for every positive real c, the one by one real matrix [c] has a basis of real eigenvectors, and for each real x the function t ↦ x + ct is strictly increasing on ℝ. Moreover, for every real-valued profile f, real derivative value a, and real point (x,t), if f has derivative a at x − ct, then the function q(ξ,τ) = f(ξ − cτ) has separate time and space derivatives at (x,t) satisfying q_t + c q_x = 0 there, and q(x + ct,t) = f(x). Second, given any positive real constants K and ρ and any supplied system of real-valued functions p,u on all of ℝ² whose separate first partial derivatives exist everywhere and satisfy p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + ρ⁻¹ p_x = 0 everywhere, there exist a positive real c equal to √(K/ρ) and a real-valued function w on all of ℝ² such that w = p + ρc u pointwise, both separate partial derivatives of w exist everywhere, and w_t + c w_x = 0 everywhere.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: All space and time coordinates range over all real numbers. There is no restriction to nonnegative time, a bounded interval, or a spatial subdomain.
The first main assertion applies only to strictly positive speeds. Its implications impose no condition for c ≤ 0.
The profile derivative assumption is local to x − ct. No global differentiability, continuity of derivatives, or joint differentiability of the profile-derived function is asserted.
For a profile lacking the specified derivative at x − ct, the profile implication is vacuous at that choice of f,a,x,t.

The identity q(x + ct,t) = f(x) is stated under the same local derivative hypothesis as the transport condition, although substitution into the supplied definition makes this identity valid without differentiability.
The profile conclusion does not specify the derivative witnesses as q_x = a and q_t = −ca, even though those identities follow from the definition and derivative hypothesis.
The spectral assertion concerns only a one-dimensional real matrix. It does not encode a spectral statement for a larger system, distinct eigenvalues, orthogonality, or a specified eigenbasis.

The second assertion is conditional on an existing system satisfying the global derivative and equation requirements. It does not construct p or u from arbitrary data. This is not an inherently empty class for positive parameters: constant functions satisfy the displayed requirements.
The system requires separate first partial derivatives everywhere, not explicitly continuous partial derivatives, joint differentiability, second derivatives, or a weak or distributional solution.

Strict positivity of K and ρ excludes zero or negative parameter cases from the second conclusion. The system's nonzero-density requirement is already implied by the target's stronger positive-density hypothesis.
The existential c is fixed by c = √(K/ρ), and the function w is fixed pointwise by p + ρc u. Existence is asserted without an explicit uniqueness clause.
The two main assertions are conjoined; the second does not explicitly identify its w with a translated profile or assert a characteristic identity for that w.
No initial or boundary conditions, general solution classification, conservation principle, physical units, or additional physical interpretation of the fields is encoded.
